title: Two Women in Trouser Suits with Toddler in Park, 1940s Snapshot Photo
description: Two stylish women wearing sharp 1940s tailored trouser suits pose kneeling on the grass of a public park alongside a young girl in a pale dress. The woman on the right casually wears a tailored jacket draped over her shoulders, embodying progressive 1940s wartime and postwar feminine tailoring where women increasingly adopted slacks and suits into everyday casual fashion. In the sunlit background, other visitors recline under large shade trees.
